name: Qwen 3.5 Plus
short: Alibaba's Qwen3.5 Plus hosted vision-language model (1M context) for agents and coding; superseded by Qwen3.6 Plus and later, measured JobBench 18.5%.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: The vision-language Plus of its generation: a hosted 1M-context agent that reads images as readily as code.
tradeoff: Superseded by Qwen 3.6 Plus and beyond, and its measured agent work already lagged the leaders — a migration-compatibility pick.
